nodes.description: uint256 constant-like total supply cap of 10000 Useless NFTs used in canMint supply check
uint256 count of minting options (6), bounds option ids and drives fireTransferEvents loop
address of OpenSea ProxyRegistry used to whitelist owner proxy in mint/isApprovedForAll
address of the UselessNFT ERC721 token contract that gets minted into
base metadata URI prefix string used by factory tokenURI
private counter in ERC721Tradable used by _getNextTokenId/_incrementTokenId when minting
public mint(uint256 _optionId,address _toAddress): asserts caller is owner proxy or owner, checks canMint and mints 1/2/5/10/20/100 NFTs to the target
public view canMint(uint256 _optionId): validates option id and returns whether remaining supply allows the allocation
public transferFrom(address,address,uint256) OpenSea compatibility shim that forwards to mint
onlyOwner function that transfers ownership of the UselessNFT instance back to the factory owner
onlyOwner override that changes factory ownership and fires transfer events for all options
onlyOwner ERC721Tradable mintTo(address _to): mints the next token id to a recipient
public payable meta-transaction entrypoint that verifies EIP712 signature and low-level calls itself with appended sender
public view factory approval shim that returns true for owner/proxy operator combinations
public view factory ownerOf(uint256) that always returns the factory owner
private helper looping over NUM_OPTIONS emitting Transfer events for each option id
caller address used for access control checks (_msgSender) in mint and as relayer in executeMetaTransaction
external contract call to UselessNFT.mintTo(address) (and transferOwnership in returnTokenContractOwnership) that transfers control to another contract
address(this).call(abi.encodePacked(functionSignature,userAddress)) low-level self call inside executeMetaTransaction
assert that the caller is the registry proxy of the owner or the owner, using proxyRegistry.proxies(owner())
for-loops in mint repeating external mintTo calls up to 100 times per transaction
uint256 _optionId parameter of mint selecting the minting batch size
address _toAddress parameter of mint, the recipient of minted NFTs
uint256 _optionId parameter of canMint used for option and supply validation
address _from parameter of transferFrom shim, unused in body
address _to parameter of transferFrom shim forwarded as the mint recipient
uint256 _tokenId parameter of transferFrom shim forwarded as the mint option id
address newOwner parameter of the transferOwnership override
uint256 numItemsAllocated local in canMint holding the requested batch size for supply math
uint256 uselessNFTsSupply local in canMint holding totalSupply of the NFT contract
UselessNFT instance local in mint cast from nftAddress and used for external mintTo calls
ProxyRegistry instance local in mint cast from proxyRegistryAddress for the caller assertion

edges.reason: _optionId parameter flows into mint to select the minting batch
_toAddress parameter flows into mint as the NFT recipient
_optionId parameter flows into canMint for option validation
_from parameter is accepted by the transferFrom shim
_to parameter flows into transferFrom and onward into mint
_tokenId parameter flows into transferFrom and is used as the mint option id
newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership
numItemsAllocated local carries the batch size used in the supply subtraction inside canMint
uselessNFTsSupply local holds the NFT totalSupply compared in canMint
uselessNFTinstance local is the target of mintTo calls issued by mint
proxyRegistry local is queried by mint for the caller authorization assertion
USELESSNFTS_SUPPLY is used in the subtraction USELESSNFTS_SUPPLY - numItemsAllocated inside canMint
NUM_OPTIONS bounds the option id compared in canMint
NUM_OPTIONS controls the loop bound of fireTransferEvents
proxyRegistryAddress is read by mint to build the ProxyRegistry instance
proxyRegistryAddress is read by isApprovedForAll to resolve the owner proxy
nftAddress is read by mint to build the UselessNFT target
nftAddress is read by canMint to query totalSupply
msg.sender (via _msgSender) gates mint through the proxy-owner assertion
msg.sender is recorded as the relayer address in executeMetaTransaction
mint performs the assert on proxyRegistry.proxies(owner()) versus the caller
mint requires canMint(_optionId) before performing any minting
mint issues external calls to UselessNFT.mintTo, granting control to another contract before accounting completes
mint executes for-loops that repeatedly invoke the external minting operation
transferFrom calls mint, exposing the privileged mint path to the shim
returnTokenContractOwnership performs an external transferOwnership call on the UselessNFT instance
executeMetaTransaction performs a low-level call to itself with appended sender, re-entering contract logic
transferOwnership calls fireTransferEvents after updating ownership
the low-level self call in executeMetaTransaction can re-enter arbitrary contract functions such as mint
the external mintTo call resolves into the NFT contract mint functionality, transferring execution control out of the factory

normalization_plan.reason: _optionId is only used to select the minting branch inside mint
_toAddress is only forwarded as the mint recipient inside mint
_optionId is only used for option and supply validation inside canMint
_from only exists in the transferFrom shim signature
_to is only forwarded to mint from the transferFrom shim
_tokenId is only forwarded as the option id from the transferFrom shim
newOwner is only consumed by the transferOwnership override
numItemsAllocated is a short-lived local of canMint used in the supply comparison
uselessNFTsSupply is a short-lived local of canMint holding the external totalSupply result
uselessNFTinstance is a short-lived local of mint used as the external mintTo target
proxyRegistry is a short-lived local of mint used for the caller authorization check
